releaseNotes:
## Downloads

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple Silicon (ARM64) | Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled `.pkg` |
| Windows 10/11, x64 (AMD64) | NSIS `.exe`, not Authenticode-signed, built without CUDA |

Intel macOS and Windows ARM64 installers are not included. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify the downloads.

## What changed

- CrossDesk Postcard now checks the `thuongtin/crossdesk` release channel instead of upstream. The macOS ARM64 installer is the bootstrap for future signed updates from this channel. This Windows build is distributed for manual installation.
- Retains Postcard, DeskHub, English as the default UI language, and uncropped 16:9 Recent Devices previews.
- The default signaling endpoint remains `crossdesk.ecom.io.vn:9099`. Existing settings and device identity are unchanged.
- Fixes the Windows build of localized Settings tray labels.
